children: SAID ON THURSDAY ISSUED SENIOR UNSECURED GREEN BONDS WORTH SEK 200 MILLION UNDER A SEK 600 MILLION FRAMEWORK
BONDS HAVE A 3.25-YEAR MATURITY AND PAY A FLOATING RATE OF 3-MONTH STIBOR PLUS 300 BASIS POINTS
PROCEEDS WILL BE USED FOR GENERAL CORPORATE PURPOSES AND IN LINE WITH GREEN FINANCING FRAMEWORK
SETTLEMENT IS EXPECTED ON OR AROUND SEPTEMBER 28, 2026
